worker_processes.description: Number of worker processes. 'auto' lets NGINX choose based on CPU cores.

error_log.description: Error log path and minimum severity level (e.g., debug, info, notice, warn, error, crit, alert, emerg).

worker_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections that can be opened by a worker process.

sendfile.description: Enable or disable use of sendfile() for efficient static file serving.

tcp_nopush.description: Enable TCP_CORK / TCP_NOPUSH — sends minimal TCP packets with full headers.

tcp_nodelay.description: Disable Nagle’s algorithm for low-latency transmission (useful for real-time apps).

keepalive_timeout.description: Time (seconds) to keep a client connection open on the server side.

types_hash_max_size.description: Maximum size of hash tables used for MIME types mapping.

enable_security_headers.description: Whether to add common security headers (X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, X-XSS-Protection).

include_conf_d.description: Whether to include *.conf files from /etc/nginx/conf.d/ (typically used for server blocks).

include_sites_enabled.description: Whether to include configs from /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/ (Debian/Ubuntu convention).

custom_server_blocks.description: List of server block configurations (e.g., for auth_request proxying). Each element defines a virtual host or auth-protected location.

listen.description: IP:port or port to listen on (e.g., '80', '443 ssl', '127.0.0.1:8080').

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required for HTTPS).

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (required for HTTPS).

auth_request_url.description: Full URL of the auth subrequest endpoint (e.g., 'https://auth.internal/auth').

auth_request_set.description: Directive to capture auth response variables (e.g., '$auth_header_x-user $auth_status').

auth_request_pass_request_body.description: Whether to pass the original request body to the auth endpoint.

locations.description: List of location blocks for this server.

auth_enabled.description: Whether to require authentication for this location.

proxy_set_headers.description: HTTP headers to pass to the backend.
